title: Civil Engineering | $100,000 - $140,000 + | Deliver SEQ's Future
abstract: Civil Engineers & Civil Designers (12d & Civil 3D users are the ideal) 3 + years exp. ideally more | Immediate project diversity
bullets: Grow as an Engineer or Designer by learning other sectors - project diversity
Small group offering more progression, development & direct support
content_text:
On Offer:
Salary | $100,000 - $140,000 + Super
⬆️Pathways into - Senior | Lead | Project Management | Design Management | Associate Director
👍Stability | A solid client base & large team to give your career stability
🏗️Multi-Sector experience
- Immediate project diversity offering your personal growth & development
- Built Environment | Land+Urban Development | Infrastructure
📝 Direct support | Immediate support from Directors / Lead Engineers + Principals
👌Culture | Flexible | No OT | Events | Love to promote from within | Training | Supportive
❤️Small group - Faster growth and less chance of being pigeonholed.
Locations:
- Brisbane
- Options in Gold Coast + Sunshine Coast as well
- WFH + flex hours offered
- Those willing to relocate to South East Queensland are welcomed apply (Aus working rights required)
✅ POSITIONS AVAILABLE:
Civil Designer or Engineer (Mid + Senior + lead positions)
- 12d or Civil 3D user are OK to apply (intermediate to advanced)
- $100K - $140K + super
- Multidisciplinary consultancy
- Civil Design or Engineering experience across any of the below sectors
- No qualifications needed although degree or diploma favoured
- Mid sized consultancy
- Positions open for growth - solid pipeline of work
- Become a Senior or PM if wanted
Senior Civil Engineer
- Immediate project diversity between Buildings, Local infrastructure + Subdivisions
- $120K - $150K + super
- 12d technical background would be ideal
- Multidisciplinary consulting group
- 20 + in the civil engineering team
Civil Project Engineer - Sunshine Coast or Brisbane
- Unique role of site and design - civil engineering
- $110K - $140K + super
- 12d technical background would be ideal
- Multidisciplinary consulting group
- 70 + in the civil engineering team
Looking for:
Experience across concept/feasibility to detailed civil design/engineering of:
- 🏘️ Subdivisions - Anything from 2 lot up to 1000+ lot subdivisions - Water & Sewer - Roads - Earthworks - wetlands - drainage
- 🏫 Built Environment - Mixed-use / InFill / Commercial, Residential, Industrial, Education - Designing the associated civils around buildings - car parks, stormwater drainage, intersections +
- 🛣️ Roads/Infrastructure - Drainage, Road alignment, pavements, intersections, roundabouts + more
It's a great time to be a Civil Designer or Engineer given the workload. I have partnered with some outstanding consulting groups who can offer amazing opportunities for those who want any of the following:
- Career progression
- Project diversity
- Market rate salaries / Pay increase
- A solid work-life balance + more...
I'd love to chat through your options and motivations, as well as discuss my clients. Please send me your CV and / or give me a call
